a direction must be transformed by matrix.to_3x3() (a 4x4 @ 3D vector also translates it)

rotation_quaternion is ignored under XYZ mode; switching rotation_mode converts the CURRENT rotation into the new mode, overwriting the quaternion you set before; set rotation_mode first, then the value
assigning obj.matrix_world sets location/rotation/scale from it
direction.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y') aims an object's -Z axis (a camera's view axis) along direction
obj.location returns a live wrapper; keep .copy() if you need the old value
